items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: When I had the hurricane, Betsy, he made a speech at the other state with Steve Lloyd.

ctx.x: Another lawyer can of his wife, huh? Yes, Bob. Pauline.

Pauline. I said, West Wiles from that neighborhood, man. Albert Oman around that neighborhood, man. Married his wife there. Oman's an old schoolboy there, man. And Steve's son is Steve Lloyd from California. Man, that guy jumped up and hugged me, man. When I had the hurricane, Betsy, he made a speech at the other state with Steve Lloyd. I said, Steve Lloyd, you know what? Hello, son. Glad to see you. Right? And then he said, you married this guy? He's great. But she don't think so.
Why didn't he tell you? Tell him. I think you got a little bit more left to go. Tell him about the visitors.
